messages:
Irene (CSM): FYI — NimblePay hit a sustained 3x burst this morning; they’re approaching their daily burst cap. We should proactively notify and offer a temporary bump. Thoughts?

Tom S.: Saw that. Can we do a one-time +25% burst increase for 48h? Also need to confirm cost owner and whether Security needs to review.

Shivani G.: Recommend a soft bump +25% and a tied throttling alert if they cross 95% again. I’ll run a quick risk check on downstream infra.

Marco (SE): I can validate — looks like spikes align to a nightly batch job. If we apply a bump we should also suggest queueing tweaks. Quick config example to propose to them:

```
# suggested rate limit change
rate_limit.window_ms = 60000
rate_limit.burst = 3500  # temp bump
# recommend client-side jitter/backoff on retries
```

Ryan (Support): I’ll draft the customer email + an in-app banner. Suggest channel: email + support ticket + banner. Template preview coming.

Tom S.: Target send: Monday 09:00 PT. I’ll own approvals and cc finance for cost signoff. Can we confirm cost delta?

Irene (CSM): Cost estimate ~ +$80/day at current usage pattern — add to the comms. Owners: Tom send email, Marco confirm technical note, Ryan create support ticket, Shivani monitor metrics and escalate if latency/error rate changes >5%.

ops-bot: Scheduled policy update queued by Tom S. for 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z — requires approval to apply temporary burst change.

Shivani G.: I’ll add a Grafana watch and set alert: `error_rate > 0.05 OR p50_latency > baseline * 1.05`. Will also create a short runbook for rollback. :thumbsup:

Marco (SE): Drafted technical guidance for the customer:
```
We recommend: 1) delay overlapping batch windows, 2) add tokenized batching to reduce peaks, 3) accept a temporary burst bump (48h) while you tune.
If you want, we can also schedule a 30-min call to walk through config.
```

Tom S.: Approved. Ryan, paste the final email here before you send so I can quickly review.

Ryan (Support): Draft below — please edit:

'Hi NimblePay team,

We noticed a sustained increase in API traffic from your account and you are approaching the daily burst cap. To avoid interruptions we can apply a temporary 25% burst increase for 48 hours starting Mon, Mar 23 09:00 PT. We will monitor the impact and revert automatically.

If you prefer a different cadence or want help tuning your batch job, we can schedule a call. Estimated additional cost: ~$80/day.

Thanks,
Ryan (Redwood Support)'

Irene (CSM): Looks good — add docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/limits-bursting and a note: 'This is proactive and reversible; no downtime expected.'

Tom S.: Added the docs link and finance approval. I’ll hit send Mon 09:00 PT and mark the support ticket as "proactive-quota-bump". Please flag here if anything changes before then. :rocket:
